blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM’s decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)可以解释自然语言的深假判断,但这种解释不一定以预测背后的视觉证据为视觉依据. 模型可以描述从语言上而不是从图像证据中推断出来的可能文物。 现有的地基方法通过解码或注意力干预来改善视觉依赖性,但是它们一般会加强整个图像的地基,使其不适合微妙的,空间局部的和图像依赖的法医文物. 我们提议在法官面前看一看,这是一个无培训框架,将可解释的深层假探测作为顺序取证过程。 我们的框架并没有直接从整体视觉推理中预测图像的真实性,而是首先通过对比MLLM的解码器到视觉的注意力来识别特定图像的候选证据区域,介于原始图像与其高斯蓝调对应物之间. 然后对已查明的区域进行单独检查,在作出最后裁决之前,将由此产生的当地证据与全球形象背景结合起来。 该框架的运作没有操纵面具,外部法证模型,或参数更新,使其直接适用于现成的MLLMs. 在TriDF和MMTD-Set上的5个开源MLLMs中,我们的框架提高了检测精度,最高达12.8%,将CHAIR降低33.4%,幻觉率降低21.3%,并且超过了有代表性的无培训解码和注意方法。

blocks.zh: 图1:在法官面前看看。 一般的MLLM产生无根据的解释和不正确的真实判断. 相反,我们的框架检查了当地候选地区,并汇总了由此产生的证据,以得出正确的被操纵的裁决。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep generative models have rapidly improved the realism of synthetic imagery, raising growing concerns about media integrity, identity verification, and digital forensics. Conventional deepfake detectors formulate deepfake detection as an image-level binary classification task, predicting whether an input is real or manipulated ( Chen et al. 2022 ; Dong et al. 2023 ; Haliassos et al. 2022 ; Han et al. 2025 ; Sun et al. 2026 ) . However, a reliable forensic analysis requires more than a binary verdict. To support trustworthy decision making, a detector should provide concrete visual evidence that justifies its prediction. Motivated by this need, recent multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based forensic methods augment image-level prediction with natural-language explanations ( Jia et al. 2024 ; Zou et al. 2025 ; Shi et al. 2025 ) . Despite their impressive fluency, the explanations often fail to faithfully reflect the visual evidence underlying the prediction. As illustrated in Figure 1 , a state-of-the-art MLLM may generate a plausible forensic explanation while overlooking annotated manipulation artifacts, ultimately producing an incorrect verdict. The key challenge of trustworthy deepfake detection is not generating explanations after prediction, but explicitly acquiring image-specific forensic evidence before making a forensic judgment.
blocks.zh: 深层基因模型迅速改进了合成图像的现实主义,引起人们对媒体完整性、身份验证和数字法医学的日益关注。 常规深假探测器将深假探测制成图像级二进制分类任务,预测输入是真实的还是被操纵的(Chen等人. 2022; 董等编. 2023; Haliassos et al. 2022; 韩等. 2025; Sun et al. 2026 ). 然而,可靠的法医学分析需要的不仅仅是二进制判决. 为了支持可信的决策,探测器应提供具体的视觉证据,为其预测提供依据。 基于这一需要,最近基于多种模式的大型语言模型(MLLM)的法证方法用自然语言解释增强了图像水平的预测(Jia等人)。 2024; 邹等. 2025; Shi等人著. 2025). 尽管这些解释令人印象深刻的流利,但往往未能忠实地反映预测背后的视觉证据。 如图1所示,最新技术的MLLM可能会在忽略附加说明的操纵文物的同时产生可信的法证解释,最终得出错误的判决。 值得信赖的深层假象探测的关键挑战不是在预测后产生解释,而是在作出法医判断前明确获取特定图像的法医证据.

blocks.en: Acquiring forensic evidence, however, is fundamentally more challenging than reasoning over semantic content. Unlike high-level semantic concepts, forensic evidence is typically weak, spatially localized, and expressed through subtle visual inconsistencies. Depending on the manipulation, the diagnostically useful cues may occur around facial structures in DeepFakes or around edited objects and regenerated regions in broader AIGC images. Under holistic image reasoning, these subtle forensic signals are easily overwhelmed by semantically dominant image content. Current MLLM-based forensic systems nevertheless attempt to localize evidence, perform reasoning, generate explanations, and predict authenticity within a unified inference process ( Xu et al. 2025 ; Huang et al. 2025 ; Kang et al. 2025 ) , making evidence acquisition an implicit of reasoning rather than an explicit objective. Although recent grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions ( An et al. 2025 ; Yin et al. 2025 ; Tang et al. 2025 ; Zhuang et al. 2025 ; Kim et al. 2025 ) , they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image or assume informative regions are already available ( Wu et al. 2024 ) . Consequently, existing approaches do not enable an off-the-shelf MLLM to autonomously identify image-specific forensic evidence before making a forensic judgment.
blocks.zh: 然而,获取法医证据比语义内容的推理更具挑战性。 与高级语义概念不同的是,法证证据一般是薄弱的,空间局部化的,并通过微妙的视觉不一致来表达. 视操纵情况而定,诊断有用的提示可能发生在DeepFakes的面部结构周围或被编辑的对象周围,并在更广泛的AIGC图像中重新生成区域. 在整体图像推理下,这些微妙的法证信号很容易被占优势的图像内容所压倒. 然而,目前的基于MLLM的法证系统试图在统一的推论过程中将证据定位、进行推理、生成解释和预测真实性(Xu等人)。 2025; 黄等. Kang等人,2025年),将获取证据作为推理的隐含而非明确的目标. 虽然最近的基础方法通过解码或注意力干预改善了视觉依赖性(An等人)。 2025; 殷等编. 2025; 唐等编. 2025;  Zhu等. 2025;Kim等人,2025年),它们总体上加强了对整个形象的支撑,或者假设信息区已经存在(Wu等人,2024年). 因此,现有方法无法使现成的MLLM在作出法医判断之前自主识别特定图像的法医证据。

blocks.en: In this work, we formulate explainable deepfake detection as a sequential, spatially grounded evidence acquisition problem rather than a single-pass explanation task. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, we advocate a look-before-you-judge paradigm in which the model first identifies image-specific regions that are likely to contain diagnostically useful evidence, inspects these regions to collect manipulation-related observations, and finally integrates the resulting local evidence with the global image context before reaching a verdict. This formulation explicitly separates evidence acquisition from decision making, making local evidence inspection a prerequisite for reliable forensic reasoning rather than a by-product of explanation generation.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们把可解释的深假探测定为一个连续的、基于空间的证据获取问题,而不是一个单一通道的解释任务。 我们不直接从整体视觉推理中预测图像真实性,而是主张一种外观前判断的范式,模型首先确定可能包含诊断性有用证据的图像特定区域,检查这些区域以收集与操纵相关的观测结果,最后将由此产生的局部证据与全球图像背景融合在一起,然后作出判断. 这种提法明确将获取证据与决策区分开来,使当地证据检查成为可靠的法证推理的先决条件,而不是解释生成的副产品.

blocks.en: Following the formulation, we propose a training-free evidence acquisition framework for off-the-shelf MLLMs. Our key insight is that image regions containing forensic evidence exhibit distinctive attention responses to fine-grained visual perturbations. We exploit this property by contrasting the MLLM’s decoder-to-visual attention between the original and blurred images, enabling the model to identify candidate evidence regions without additional supervision. The identified regions are subsequently inspected individually, and the resulting local observations are integrated with the global image context for final prediction. Since the entire pipeline relies solely on the deployed MLLM’s test-time attention responses, our framework is self-contained and requires neither manipulation masks, predefined facial priors, external forensic encoders, learned localization modules, nor task-specific training.
blocks.zh: 在拟定之后,我们提出一个现成的MLLM的无培训证据获取框架。 我们的主要见解是,包含法医证据的图像区域对细微的视觉扰动表现出了独特的关注。 我们利用这一财产,将MLLM对原始图像和模糊图像的解码器对视觉的注意加以对比,使模型能够在没有额外监督的情况下确定备选证据区域。 随后对已查明的区域进行单独检查,结果得出的局部观测结果与全球图像环境相结合,以便进行最后预测。 由于整个管道完全依赖于所部署的MLLM的测试时间关注响应,我们的框架是自成一体的,既不需要操纵口罩,预先定义的面部前科,外部法医编码器,学习的本地化模块,也不需要任务特定培训.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce a look-before-you-judge formulation for explainable deepfake detection, which explicitly separates region discovery, local evidence inspection, and final image-level judgment. This formulation addresses the missing pre-decision inspection stage in existing MLLM-based forensic reasoning. • Based on this formulation, we develop a fully training-free test-time evidence acquisition framework that identifies detail-sensitive forensic regions through blur-contrastive attention analysis and guides the MLLM to inspect them without manipulation masks, task-specific training, or learned localization modules. • Extensive experiments across five open-source MLLM backbones and two benchmarks covering diverse deepfake manipulations and AIGC editing demonstrate consistent improvements in both detection accuracy and explanation grounding, validating the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed framework.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提出一种在法官面前看问题的办法,以进行可解释的深层假探测,明确区分区域发现、当地证据检查和最终图像级判断。 这一提法解决了现有基于MLLM的法证推理中缺少的决定前检查阶段. • 支助 基于这一提法,我们开发了一个完全免费的测试时间证据获取框架,通过模糊的关联性关注分析确定对详细敏感的法证区,并指导MLLM在没有操纵口罩、任务特定培训或学习的本地化模块的情况下对其进行检查。 • 在五个开放源码的MLLM主干线上进行广泛的试验,并制订两个基准,涵盖各种深层操纵和AIGC编辑,显示在探测准确度和解释基础方面不断改进,验证拟议框架的有效性和普遍性。

blocks.en: We introduce a look-before-you-judge formulation for explainable deepfake detection, which explicitly separates region discovery, local evidence inspection, and final image-level judgment. This formulation addresses the missing pre-decision inspection stage in existing MLLM-based forensic reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一种在法官面前看问题的办法,以进行可解释的深层假探测,明确区分区域发现、当地证据检查和最终图像级判断。 这一提法解决了现有基于MLLM的法证推理中缺少的决定前检查阶段.

blocks.en: Based on this formulation, we develop a fully training-free test-time evidence acquisition framework that identifies detail-sensitive forensic regions through blur-contrastive attention analysis and guides the MLLM to inspect them without manipulation masks, task-specific training, or learned localization modules.
blocks.zh: 基于这一提法,我们开发了一个完全免费的测试时间证据获取框架,通过模糊的关联性关注分析确定对详细敏感的法证区,并指导MLLM在没有操纵口罩、任务特定培训或学习的本地化模块的情况下对其进行检查。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments across five open-source MLLM backbones and two benchmarks covering diverse deepfake manipulations and AIGC editing demonstrate consistent improvements in both detection accuracy and explanation grounding, validating the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed framework.
blocks.zh: 涉及五个开放源码的MLLM主干线和两个基准的广泛实验,包括各种深层操纵和AIGC的编辑显示,在检测准确度和解释基础方面都不断改进,验证了拟议框架的有效性和普遍性。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: From Detection to Local Evidence Inspection
blocks.zh: 从侦测到当地证据检查

blocks.en:
Early deepfake detectors formulate forgery detection as image-level binary classification, typically trained on large-scale datasets such as FaceForensics++ ( Rossler et al. 2019 ) and DFDC ( Dolhansky et al. 2020 ) . Although effective in controlled settings, these models often rely on dataset-specific artifacts and may generalize poorly to unseen generators ( Rossler et al. 2019 ; Dolhansky et al. 2020 ) . Later methods incorporate forgery-aware priors to improve robustness ( Liu et al. 2024 ; Yang et al. 2025 ) , but still mainly provide image-level predictions without exposing local evidence.
Recent MLLM-based image forensic systems, such as FakeShield ( Xu et al. 2025 ) , SIDA ( Huang et al. 2025 ) , and LEGION ( Kang et al. 2025 ) , extend detection toward interpretable forgery analysis by producing textual explanations and, in some cases, localization outputs. However, their localization and explanation are typically obtained through supervised training on annotated masks, artifact labels, or curated explanation data, and are generated jointly with the final decision. Our work neither learns localization from annotated data nor directly asks the MLLM for a global explanation. Instead, it first mines candidate forensic regions from the model’s own test-time attention responses, enabling a look-before-you-judge inspection of local evidence prior to the final judgment.
blocks.zh:
早期的深假探测器会将伪造探测作为图像级的二进制分类,通常在FaceForensics++等大型数据集上训练. (Rossler等人,2019年)和DFDC (Dolhansky等人,2020年). 这些模型虽然在受控环境下有效,但往往依赖于数据集特有的文物,并可能无法很好地概括到看不见的发电机(Rossler等人)。 2019; Dolhansky et al. 2020) (中文(中国大陆) ). 后来的方法包括了伪造前科,以提高坚固性(Liu等人)。 2024 ; Yang et al. 2025 ),但仍主要提供图像水平的预测,而不暴露当地证据.
最近的基于MLLM的图像法证系统,如假盾(徐等人,2025年),SIDA(黄等人,2025年)和LEGION(姜等人,2025年),通过提供文字解释和在某些情况下本地化输出,将检测扩展到可解释的伪造分析. 然而,其本地化和解释通常是通过关于附加说明的口罩、文物标签或整理解释数据的有监督的培训获得的,并与最后决定一起产生。 我们的工作既不从附加说明的数据中学习本地化,也不直接要求MLLM作出全球解释. 取而代之的是,它首先从模型本身的试验时间注意答复中选取了法医区域,以便能够在最后判决之前在法官面前查看当地证据。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of Look Before You Judge . Stage 1 derives a blur-sensitive visual prior by contrasting output-to-visual attention between the input image and its blurred counterpart. Stage 2 constructs candidate forensic regions from high-response tokens. Stage 3 performs region-wise inspection with attention steering and aggregates the filtered evidence to produce the final prediction and explanation. The entire framework is training-free and requires only frozen MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 图2: " 在你面前看 " 概览 第1阶段通过将输入图像与其模糊的对应物之间的输出到视觉的注意力对比而获得模糊的敏感视觉。 第2阶段从高响应信号构建候选法医区域。 第三阶段按区域进行视察,并进行指导,汇总过滤的证据,以便作出最后预测和解释。 整个框架是免费的,只要求冻结的MLLMs.

blocks.en: Visual Grounding and Forensic Localization
blocks.zh: 视觉地面和法医定位

blocks.en: Recent studies have linked MLLM hallucination to insufficient visual grounding and an excessive reliance on language priors, motivating a growing body of training-free methods that intervene in attention or decoding at inference time ( Lu et al. 2026 ; Basile et al. 2026 ; Tu et al. 2026 ; Huang et al. 2024 ; Leng et al. 2024 ) . While these approaches generally improve the model’s reliance on visual information, they predominantly operate at the whole-image level. Such global interventions may be suboptimal for forensic analysis, where discriminative artifacts are often sparse and confined to small regions of the image. ControlMLLM ( Wu et al. 2024 ) enables attention steering toward designated image regions, but assumes that the regions of interest are specified in advance.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究将MLLM幻觉与视觉定位不足和过度依赖语言前科联系起来,促使越来越多的无培训方法干预注意力或在推断时间解码(Lu等人)。 2026; 巴西尔等. 页:1 2024; Leng et al. 2024 (英语). 虽然这些方法普遍改进了模型对视觉信息的依赖,但它们主要在全图像层面运作。 这种全球干预对于法医学分析可能不尽人意,因为歧视性文物往往很少,而且局限于形象的小区域。 ControlMLM(Wu等人,2024年)使得注意力能够引导到指定的图像区域,但假设感兴趣的区域是事先指定的.

blocks.en: In parallel, existing forensic approaches extract localized evidence using frequency-domain priors ( Qian et al. 2020 ) , gradient-based saliency ( Selvaraju et al. 2017 ) , or dedicated localization networks ( Li et al. 2020 ; Xu et al. 2025 ; Kang et al. 2025 ) . LAA-Net ( Nguyen et al. 2024 ) further reduces the dependence on explicit manipulation masks by learning attention over artifact-prone regions. Nevertheless, its localization behavior remains governed by task-specific training objectives and the artifact distributions represented in the training data.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,现有的法证方法利用频率域前传(Qian 等人,2020年),梯度性优势(Selvaraju等人,2017年),或专用本地化网络(Li等人,2020年)提取本地化证据. 2020; 许等. 2025; Kang等人 2025). LAA-Net (Nguyen等人 2024)通过学习对文物易发地区的关注,进一步减少了对明确操纵口罩的依赖. 尽管如此,其本地化行为仍受特定任务培训目标以及培训数据中体现的文物分布的制约.

blocks.en: These two lines of research therefore address complementary, yet incomplete, aspects of explainable forensic reasoning. Training-free grounding methods strengthen visual reliance without explicitly identifying where forensic evidence is located, whereas forensic localization methods typically depend on task-specific supervision or dedicated localization components. Our method bridges this gap by automatically deriving image-specific forensic regions from an MLLM’s inference-time attention responses. This enables region-wise evidence inspection without localization supervision, auxiliary localization modules, or parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 因此,这两条研究线涉及可解释的法证推理的互补但不完整的方面。 无培训的地基方法加强视觉依赖,而没有明确确定法证证据所在,而法证本地化方法通常取决于具体任务的监督或专门的本地化部分。 我们的方法通过自动从MLLM的推断-时间关注反应中得出特定图像的法证区来弥补这一差距。 这使得在不进行本地化监管、辅助本地化模块或参数更新的情况下,能够进行区域证据检查。

blocks.en: Method
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: We introduce a training-free framework that uses an MLLM’s output-to-visual attention to determine where to inspect before making an image-level judgment. As shown in Figure 2 , it discovers and inspects detail-sensitive regions and verifies the evidence retained under an undirected global view.
blocks.zh: 我们采用一个无培训框架,利用MLLM的输出到视觉关注来确定在作出图像级判断之前检查何处。 如图2所示,它发现和检查了对细节敏感的区域,并核实了在非定向全球观点下保留的证据。

blocks.en: The mined visual prior is authenticity-agnostic : it serves only as a proposal signal for subsequent forensic inspection. Because all candidate regions and steering distributions are derived from test-time attention, the framework requires no manipulation masks, predefined facial regions, auxiliary modules, or parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 被挖掘的视觉前是真实的不可知性的:它只是随后法医检查的建议信号。 由于所有候选区域和方向分布都是来自测试时的注意,所以框架不需要操纵口罩,预先定义的面部区域,辅助模块,或者参数更新.

blocks.en: Stage 1: Blur-Sensitive Visual Prior Mining
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:模糊的视觉先行采矿

blocks.en: Stage 1 mines a token-level blur-sensitive prior that highlights visual tokens whose attention responses depend on fine-grained image detail. Because Gaussian blur suppresses such detail while largely preserving coarse image structure, reduced output-to-visual attention under blur provides a useful signal for forensic region mining.
blocks.zh: 第1阶段地雷是一种标志级模糊的敏感前兆,它突出显示视线标志,其注意力反应取决于精细的图像细节。 由于高斯模糊压制了这种细节,同时基本上保留了粗糙的图像结构,因此模糊度下的输出对视觉的注意减少,为法证区开采提供了有用的信号.

blocks.en: We analyze decoder self-attention from generated response tokens to visual tokens, rather than the vision encoder’s internal patch attention, as it reflects the visual evidence consulted while producing the forensic response.
blocks.zh: 我们分析从生成的响应符到视觉信号的解码器自我注意,而不是视觉编码器的内部补丁注意,因为它反映了在产生法证反应时所参考的视觉证据.

blocks.en: Given a raw image I I , we construct a Gaussian-blurred counterpart I blur I^{\mathrm{blur}} . To avoid confounding visual changes with different textual continuations, we generate a response from I I and reuse its token sequence as a fixed, teacher-forced continuation for both inputs.
blocks.zh: 以原始形象为例, 我们构建一个高斯蓝调的对应物, 为了避免将视觉变化与不同的文字续作混淆,我们从I生成一个响应,并重用其符号序列作为两种输入的固定的,教师强制的续作.

blocks.en: Datasets and Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate our framework on TriDF Type-B <OEQ> ( Jiang-Lin et al. 2026 ) and MMTD-Set ( Xu et al. 2025 ) . TriDF provides artifact-level annotations, enabling joint evaluation of authenticity prediction and explanation grounding. We report accuracy (ACC), artifact coverage (Cover), CHAIR, hallucination rate (Hal), and F 0.5 F^{0.5} on TriDF. Cover measures the recall of annotated artifacts, whereas CHAIR and Hal quantify unsupported artifact claims. The F 0.5 F^{0.5} score summarizes the trade-off between artifact precision and coverage, with greater emphasis on precision. On MMTD-Set, we report ACC and F1 on the DeepFake and AIGC-Editing subsets.

blocks.en: Generalization across MLLM Backbones. Our framework consistently improves image-level accuracy while substantially reducing CHAIR and hallucination rates across all five evaluated open-source MLLM backbones, demonstrating robust generalization across diverse architectures. For example, InternVL-3.5-8B improves accuracy from 0.418 to 0.546 while reducing CHAIR from 0.975 to 0.641. Although artifact coverage decreases for some models, these reductions are consistently accompanied by lower CHAIR and hallucination rates, indicating a shift toward more selective and better-supported artifact descriptions rather than exhaustive but potentially unsupported enumeration.
blocks.zh: 跨越MLLM Backbones的通用化. 我们的框架不断提高图像水平的准确性,同时大幅降低所有五个经评价的开放源代码MLLM主干网的CHAIR和幻觉率,表明在各种架构中都得到了有力的概括。 例如,InternVL-3.5-8B将精度从0.418提高到0.546,同时将CHAIR从0.975降至0.641. 虽然某些模型的人工制品覆盖率下降,但伴随这些下降的始终是降低主席职位和幻觉率,这表明人们转向更有选择性和有更好依据的人工制品描述,而不是详尽无遗,但有可能是无根据的。

blocks.en: Generalization across Benchmarks. We further evaluate our framework on MMTD-Set. Our framework improves both ACC and F1 across nearly all model–subset combinations on the DeepFake and AIGC-Editing subsets. Together with the results on TriDF, which also covers diverse manipulation types, these consistent gains demonstrate that the framework generalizes across benchmark datasets and heterogeneous manipulation scenarios.
blocks.zh: 跨基准的概括。 我们进一步评估我们的MMTD-Set框架。 我们的框架在几乎所有的模型-DeepFake和AIGC-Editing子集上的子集组合中都改进了ACC和F1。 这些一致的成果与关于三联基金的成果(其中也涵盖各种操纵类型)一起,表明框架将各种基准数据集和各种操纵情景概括起来。

blocks.en: Comparison with Commercial MLLMs. For reference, we also compare our framework against several commercial MLLMs evaluated under vanilla inference. While these proprietary models generally outperform open-source MLLMs under vanilla inference, applying our framework substantially narrows the gap. In several cases, the enhanced open-source models achieve comparable or even superior explanation grounding despite requiring neither additional training nor proprietary components. These results suggest that effective test-time evidence acquisition can be as critical as model scaling for explainable forensic reasoning.
blocks.zh: 与商业的 MLLMs 进行比较。我们还将我们的框架与根据香草推论评估的几个商业 MLLMs 进行比较,以供参考。 虽然这些专有模式在香草推论下一般超过开源的MLLMs,但运用我们的框架大大缩小了差距。 在某些情况下,强化的开源模型可以实现可比甚至更好的解释,尽管不需要额外的培训或专有成分。 这些结果表明,有效的测试时间证据的获取可以同模型规模化的可解释法证推理一样重要。

blocks.en: Comparison with Training-Free Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: 与无培训视觉地面的比较

blocks.en: We further compare our framework with VCD ( Leng et al. 2024 ) and AttnReal ( Tu et al. 2026 ) , two representative training-free visual grounding methods that improve visual reliance during inference without additional training. As shown in Table 2 , all methods are evaluated using the same InternVL-3.5-8B backbone and TriDF setting. VCD and AttnReal yield only marginal gains over vanilla inference: improvements in ACC and Cover are limited, CHAIR and Hal remain nearly unchanged, and F 0.5 F^{0.5} decreases. In contrast, our framework improves all five metrics, reducing CHAIR from 0.9745 0.9745 to 0.6407 0.6407 together with a marked decrease in Hal. These results indicate that globally strengthening visual reliance is insufficient for deepfake forensics; effective grounding instead requires spatially selective region discovery and inspection before the final judgment.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将我们的框架与VCD(Leng等人,2024年)和AttnReal(Tu等人,2026年)相比较,这两种具有代表性的无培训视觉地面测量方法,在推论中,在没有额外训练的情况下,改进了视觉依赖. 如表2所示,所有方法都使用相同的InternVL-3.5-8B主干线和TriDF设置进行评估. 与香草推论相比,VCD和AttnReal只获得微小收益:ACC和Cover的改进有限,Chair和Hal几乎保持不变,F 0.5 F^{0.5}减少。 相比之下,我们的框架改进了所有五个度量,将主席职位从0.9745 0.9745减少到0.6407 0.6407,同时哈尔明显减少。 这些结果表明,全球加强视觉依赖不足以进行深层法证;而有效的地面定位则需要在空间上有选择地进行区域发现和检查,然后再作出最后判断。

Bottom: Our framework discovers three candidate regions, inspects them independently, and aggregates the retained local evidence under a global view to produce the correct manipulated verdict.

blocks.en: We conduct an ablation study on TriDF using InternVL-3.5-8B to evaluate the look-before-you-judge procedure, blur-contrastive region mining, and connected-component steering. Table 3 compares Vanilla , Prompt-only , w/o blur contrast , w/o component steering , and the full framework.
blocks.zh: 我们利用InternVL-3.5-8B对TriDF进行扩展研究,以评估法官面前的外观程序、模糊的争议区域采矿和连接组件指导。 表3比较了“香草”、“快速”、“W/o模糊对比”、“w/o 组件引导”和“完整框架”。

blocks.en: Prompted evidence is not necessarily grounded. The prompt-only variant improves detection and artifact coverage over Vanilla , but leaves hallucination metrics largely unchanged. This shows that eliciting more evidence does not ensure that the reported observations are visually supported.
blocks.zh: 迅速提供的证据不一定有根据。 但幻觉度量基本不变。 这表明,获得更多证据并不能确保所报告的观察得到视觉支持。

blocks.en: Region discovery matters. Using raw attention instead of the blur-contrastive prior underperforms even the prompt-only variant, suggesting that globally salient responses do not reliably expose subtle forensic cues. Effective inspection therefore depends on first discovering informative, detail-sensitive regions.
blocks.zh: 区域发现事项. 使用原始的注意而不是模糊的前后矛盾的先行表现,甚至是即时的变体,说明全球突出的反应不能可靠地暴露微妙的法证提示. 因此,有效检查取决于首先发现信息丰富、细节敏感的区域。

blocks.en: Separate inspection improves grounding. Without component-level steering, a single global prior mixes spatially distinct cues and weakens focused inspection. In contrast, the full framework achieves the best overall performance, validating the complete look-before-you-judge pipeline of region discovery, separate inspection, and evidence aggregation.
blocks.zh: 单独的检查改善了地面。 没有组件级的引导,单一的全球前置组合在空间上截然不同的提示并削弱重点检查。 与此相反,整个框架取得了最佳的总体业绩,验证了区域发现、单独检查和证据汇总的全貌 -- -- 即由法官审理的流程。

blocks.en: Qualitative Spatial Grounding
blocks.zh: 定性空间定位

blocks.en: We qualitatively examine whether regions discovered before judgment correspond to actual manipulation areas. Figure 3 visualizes the top candidate regions produced by blur-contrastive region mining and connected-component grouping on fake images from the DeepFake subset of MMTD-Set. Although the framework is not trained for localization and does not access ground-truth masks during inference, the discovered regions frequently cover manipulated facial boundaries and locally edited structures. These examples suggest that the proposed procedure produces meaningful inspection targets for acquiring local evidence before final judgment.
blocks.zh: 我们从质量上审查在判决前发现的区域是否与实际操纵地区相对应。 图3可视化通过模糊的相容区域开采和连接组件组合在MMTD-Set的DeepFake子集的假图像上产生的顶级候选区域. 虽然框架没有经过本地化培训,在推论期间没有获得地面真实面具,但发现的地区经常覆盖被操纵的面部界限和当地编辑的结构. 这些例子表明,拟议程序产生了有意义的检查目标,以便在最后判决之前获得当地证据。

blocks.en: Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows how the proposed look-before-you-judge procedure corrects an erroneous global judgment. Vanilla inference predicts the manipulated image as authentic based on broad claims of consistent skin tone and seamless facial integration. In contrast, our framework identifies candidate regions around the eyes, facial boundary, and jawline, where region-wise inspection reveals blending artifacts, abnormal smoothness, and texture inconsistencies. Aggregating these locally grounded observations under the global view leads to the correct manipulated verdict. Additional examples and failure cases are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 图4显示拟议的法官前外观程序如何纠正一个错误的全球判断。 香草推论预测被操纵的图像是真实的,基于对一致皮肤色调和无缝面部融合的广泛说法. 对比之下,我们的框架确定了在眼睛、面部界限和下颚周围的候选区域,在这些区域中,按区域进行的检查揭示出混合文物、异常光滑和纹理不一致。 将这些基于地方的观测结果汇总到全球观点之下,就会导致被操纵的正确判断。 补充材料中提供了其他例子和失败案例。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Look Before You Judge , a formulation that casts explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition problem rather than a single-pass prediction task. Based on this formulation, we develop a fully training-free test-time evidence acquisition framework that identifies detail-sensitive candidate regions from blur-contrastive attention responses, inspects them individually, and integrates the resulting local evidence into a final image-level judgment. The framework operates entirely at inference time on frozen MLLMs, requiring neither localization supervision, auxiliary modules, nor parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍“在你法官面前看”这一说法,它把可解释的深度假探测作为连续取证问题,而不是单路预测任务。 基于这一提法,我们开发了一个完全免费的测试时间证据获取框架,从模糊的争论性注意反应中找出对细节敏感的候选区域,逐个检查,并将由此产生的当地证据纳入最终的图像级判断. 该框架完全在对冻结的MLLMs进行推论时运行,既不需要本地化监督,辅助模块,也不需要参数更新.

blocks.en: Experiments across five open-source MLLMs and two benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in detection accuracy and explanation grounding. Together with the ablation and qualitative analyses, these results support the central premise of Look Before You Judge : trustworthy forensic reasoning should first identify where potential evidence resides, then examine it locally, and only afterward reach a global conclusion. We hope this work motivates future research on evidence-centric DeepFake detection, where explicit evidence acquisition becomes a fundamental component of trustworthy and interpretable decision making beyond deepfake detection.
blocks.zh: 5个公开源代码的MLLM和2个基准的实验表明,探测准确度和解释基础持续提高。 这些结果与减退和定性分析一起,支持了 " 在你判断之前看 " 的核心前提:可信赖的法证推理应首先确定可能的证据存在在何处,然后在当地审查,然后才能得出全球结论。 我们希望这项工作能激发今后对以证据为中心的深假探测的研究,在该研究中,明确的证据获取成为超出深假探测范围可信和可解释的决策的一个基本组成部分。

blocks.en: A. Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: A. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The blur-contrastive attention prior in our framework should be interpreted as a proposal mechanism for acquiring evidence rather than as a causal attribution of the model’s decision. Our framework does not imply that the selected regions are the sole causes of the final prediction. Instead, they serve as probes for identifying the MLLM’s evidence-sensitive attention head, which are subsequently leveraged to recognize candidate forensic evidence.
blocks.zh: 在我们的框架之前的模糊的争论性注意应被解释为获得证据的建议机制,而不是模型决定的因果关系。 我们的框架并不意味着选定的区域是最后预测的唯一原因。 反之,它们充当探测器,用以确定MLLM对证据敏感的关注头目,这些头目随后被用来识别候选法证。

blocks.en: On the other hand, our framework inherits several limitations from its training-free design. First, because candidate evidence regions are proposed through blur-contrastive attention responses, the framework naturally emphasizes artifacts that are sensitive to local high-frequency perturbations, potentially making it less effective for manipulations characterized by more subtle low-frequency inconsistencies. Future work could explore richer perturbation strategies or adaptive mechanisms to improve coverage across diverse manipulation types. Second, the framework requires white-box access to decoder attention, limiting its applicability to open-weight MLLMs. Extending evidence acquisition to black-box models remains an important direction for future research. Finally, the quality of the acquired evidence depends on the preservation of fine-grained visual details, and performance may degrade under severe compression, downsampling, or coarse visual-token representations. Incorporating multi-scale visual representations or resolution-aware evidence acquisition may further improve robustness in such scenarios.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,我们的框架继承了其免费培训设计的若干限制。 第一,由于候选证据区域是通过模糊的前后不一的注意反应提出的,因此框架自然强调对当地高频扰动敏感的文物,有可能使其对以更微妙的低频不一致为特征的操纵效果降低. 今后的工作可以探索更丰富的扰动战略或适应机制,以提高各种操纵类型的覆盖面。 第二,框架要求白盒访问可以解码器注意,将其应用限制在开放量的MLLMs. 将证据获取范围扩大到黑盒模型仍然是未来研究的一个重要方向. 最后,获得的证据的质量取决于保存精细的视觉细节,性能可能会在严重的压缩,下采样,或粗糙的视觉脚趾表现下退化. 纳入多层次的视觉表现或了解分辨率的证据收集,可进一步提高这种情景的稳健性。

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, we believe the proposed evidence acquisition formulation, look-before-you-judge , provides a flexible foundation that can accommodate more advanced proposal mechanisms, perturbation strategies, and visual representations as future MLLMs continue to evolve.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性,但我们认为,拟议的证据获取方案,即 " 法官前看 " ,提供了一个灵活的基础,可以容纳更先进的提案机制、扰动战略和视觉表达,因为未来的MLLMs在不断发展。

blocks.en: B. Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: B. 评价计量

blocks.en: We adopt the evaluation protocol of TriDF ( Jiang-Lin et al. 2026 ) without modification, and report standard binary classification metrics on MMTD-Set ( Xu et al. 2025 ) . Because the artifact-level metrics are central to our claims about explanation grounding, we restate their definitions here so that our numbers can be interpreted and reproduced without reference to the original paper.
blocks.zh: 我们通过TriDF的评价协议(Jiang-Lin等人,2026年),未作修改,并在MMTD-Set上报告标准二进制分类指标(徐等人,2025年). 由于文物级的衡量标准是我们关于解释理由的主张的核心,我们在此重申它们的定义,以便我们的数字可以在不参考原始文件的情况下被解释和复制。

blocks.en: C. Self-Proposed Regions
blocks.zh: C. 自我建议的区域

blocks.en: We further examine whether the gains of our framework can be explained merely by multi-stage prompting or textual region decomposition. In this baseline, the MLLM first proposes up to three small localized regions for close inspection. The same region-level inspection and final verification procedure is then applied, but without blur-contrastive region mining or attention reallocation.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查我们框架的成果能否仅仅通过多阶段催化或文字区域分解来解释。 在这一基线中,劳动和劳工部首先提出至多三个小的局部地区进行严密检查。 然后采用同样的区域一级的视察和最后核查程序,但不会模糊不清的区域采矿或重新分配注意力。

blocks.en: As shown in Table S1 , Self-Proposed Region Inspection improves over vanilla inference, indicating that explicitly decomposing the task into local inspection and final aggregation can provide a useful reasoning structure. However, it does not outperform Prompt-only on ACC, Cover, CHAIR, or F 0.5 F^{0.5} , and remains substantially behind our full framework. This suggests that asking the model to propose and inspect its own regions does not reliably identify manipulation-relevant evidence; the selected regions may still be driven by semantic saliency or language priors rather than image-specific forensic cues.
blocks.zh: 如表S1所示,自提议区域视察比香草推论有所改进,表明将任务明确分解为地方视察和最后汇总可提供一个有用的推理结构。 然而,它在ACC、Cover、CAIR或F 0.5 F^{0.5}方面的表现并不优于《快速》,而且在很大程度上仍然落后于我们的全面框架。 这表明,要求模型提出和检查其所在区域并不能可靠地确定与操纵相关的证据;选定的区域可能仍然受到语义特征或语言前传而不是图像特定法证提示的驱动。

blocks.en: In contrast, our full framework achieves the strongest overall performance across detection, artifact grounding, and hallucination reduction. These results show that effective look-before-you-judge reasoning requires more than textual region decomposition: the model must first discover detail-sensitive, image-specific regions and inspect them under region-specific attention steering.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,我们的全面框架在探测、人工筑地和减少幻觉方面取得了最强的整体业绩。 这些结果表明,在法官面前有效的外观推理需要的不仅仅是文字区域分解:模型必须首先发现细节敏感、图像特定区域,并在区域具体关注的指导下对其进行检查。

blocks.en: D. Alternative Region Source
blocks.zh: D. 替代区域来源

blocks.en: We further examine whether the gains of our framework can be reproduced by steering the model toward predefined facial components. Such anatomical priors are a well-established source of localized supervision in face forensics: DFD-FCG ( Han et al. 2025 ) adapts a foundation model for video-based deepfake detection through facial-component guidance, and Face-LLaVA ( Chaubey et al. 2026 ) injects face-region priors into an MLLM through face-region guided cross-attention. Both indicate that directing a model’s capacity toward facial parts is beneficial, which makes a facial-component prior the natural non-learned alternative to our mined regions. We therefore construct a facial-region variant that replaces Stages 1–2 with landmark-based eye, nose, and mouth regions, and distributes the recycled attention uniformly within each region. All remaining settings, including the region-inspection prompt, intervention layers, evidence filtering, and final aggregation, are kept identical to the full method.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查我们框架的成果是否能够通过引导模型转向预先界定的面部组件来复制。 这种解剖学前科是面对法证的本地化监管的可靠来源:DFD-FCG(Han 等人,2025年)通过面部元件指导修改了基于视频的深假检测的基础模型,Face-LLaVA(Chaubey等人,2026年)通过面部区域引导交叉观察将面部区域前科注入MLLM. 两者都表明,将模型的能力引导到面部部部位是有好处的,这使得面部部部位在自然未被挖掘出来之前就成为了我们雷区的替代品。 因此,我们构建了一个面部区域变体,用标志性的眼睛、鼻子和口腔区域取代第1至第2阶段,并在每个区域统一分配回收的注意力。 其余所有设置,包括区域检查即时设置、干预层、证据过滤和最后汇总,均与全方法完全相同。

blocks.en: The facial-region variant substantially improves over vanilla inference across both detection and explanation-grounding metrics. This result shows that decomposing the image into local inspection regions and reallocating attention during region-wise evidence acquisition is itself effective, even when the candidate regions are defined by a simple face-centric prior. In other words, part of the improvement comes from explicitly directing the model to inspect localized visual evidence before making the final judgment.
blocks.zh: 面部-区域变异大大改进了从检测和解释依据两方面的推断。 这一结果表明,将图像分解到地方检查区,并在获取区域证据过程中重新分配注意力,这本身是有效的,即使候选区域是由简单的面部中心前界定的。 换句话说,部分改进来自于明确指示模型在作出最后判断之前检查局部视觉证据.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the full method consistently performs best across all metrics. Since the downstream inspection and aggregation procedures are unchanged, this remaining gap indicates that the effectiveness of regional attention reallocation depends not only on applying the intervention, but also on where the redistributed attention is directed. Predefined facial components provide useful inspection targets for face-related artifacts, but they may spend the limited region budget on less informative facial areas or fail to cover manipulations located elsewhere in the image. In contrast, our blur-contrastive prior derives image-specific regions from the input itself, allowing the inspection targets to adapt across facial manipulations, edited objects, and regenerated image regions. This adaptability is particularly important for settings such as image editing, where the face may occupy only a small portion of the image and the diagnostically useful evidence may instead appear in non-facial content.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,整个方法在所有衡量标准方面始终表现最佳。 由于下游的检查和汇总程序没有改变,这一尚存的差距表明,区域注意力重新分配的有效性不仅取决于采取干预措施,还取决于重新分配注意力的方向。 预先定义的面部元件为面部相关的文物提供了有用的检查目标,但它们可能会将有限的区域预算花在信息较少的面部区域上,或者无法覆盖图像中其他地方的操纵. 反之,我们模糊的前后矛盾的 图像特定区域 来源于输入本身, 让检查目标 适应 面部操纵, 编辑对象, 再生成图像区域。 这种适应性对于图像编辑等环境尤其重要,因为图像的面部可能只占图像的一小部分,而诊断有用的证据则可能出现在非表面内容中.

blocks.en: E. Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: E. 定性结果

blocks.en: We provide three additional examples of successful cases and one representative failure case. These examples show how region mining and region-wise inspection can correct erroneous global judgments, improve explanation grounding, and calibrate ambiguous local evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了成功案例的另外三个例子和一个有代表性的失败案例。 这些例子表明,区域采矿和区域视察如何能够纠正错误的全球判断,改进解释基础,并校准模棱两可的地方证据。

blocks.en: Figures S1 and S2 show complementary cases in which our framework corrects vanilla inference. In the manipulated image generation example, vanilla relies on broad claims of natural appearance and overlooks localized blur and texture inconsistencies. Our framework inspects the discovered regions and integrates the resulting evidence into the correct manipulated verdict.
blocks.zh: 图S1和S2显示了补充性案例,我们的框架纠正了香草推论。 在被操纵的图像生成例子中,香草依赖于对自然外观的广泛主张,忽略了局部模糊和纹理不一致. 我们的框架检查已发现的地区,并将由此产生的证据纳入被操纵的正确判决。

blocks.en: In the authentic-face example, vanilla instead hallucinates manipulation cues around the hair, skin, and eyes. Although our framework also selects locally ambiguous regions, it describes them with low evidential strength and retains a negative observation. Global aggregation rejects the unsupported cues and produces the correct authentic prediction. Together, these examples show that the method calibrates local evidence rather than simply increasing sensitivity to manipulation.
blocks.zh: 在真实的面部例子中,香草代替幻觉在头发,皮肤和眼睛周围发出操纵提示. 虽然我们的框架也选择了当地模糊不清的地区,但是它以较低的证据强度描述这些地区,并保留了负面的观察. 全球聚合拒绝不支持的提示并产生正确的真实预测. 这些例子共同表明,该方法校准了当地的证据,而不是仅仅提高了对操纵的敏感性.

blocks.en: Figure S3 shows that a correct verdict does not necessarily imply a grounded explanation. Vanilla correctly predicts manipulation but describes generic hair and background anomalies. Our framework instead links its findings to inspected regions around the hairline and forehead, where the observed blending and texture irregularities more closely match the annotated artifacts. The final explanation is therefore more localized and visually traceable.
blocks.zh: 图S3显示,正确的判决并不一定意味着有根据的解释。 香草正确预测了操纵,但描述了一般的头发和背景异常. 相反,我们的框架将调查结果与检查过的发线和前额周围区域联系起来,在这些区域,观察到的混合和纹理不合规定之处与附加说明的文物更接近。 因此,最后的解释更具有局部性和可视性。

blocks.en: Figure S4 presents a manipulated image that both methods classify as authentic. Vanilla supports its decision using broad claims about natural scene appearance. Our framework provides a more localized observation by identifying blur in the railway background, but this cue remains ambiguous because it may also result from natural focus variation. Moreover, the selected regions do not reveal sufficiently strong complementary evidence of blending, color inconsistency, or object-integrity flaws.
blocks.zh: 图S4呈现出一种被操纵的图像,两种方法都归类为真实. 香草公司支持其决定,使用对自然场景外观的广泛说法. 我们的框架通过识别铁路背景的模糊性提供了更本地化的观察,但这一提示仍然模糊不清,因为它也可能是自然焦点变化的结果。 此外,所选区域没有显示足够有力的混合、颜色不一致或物体完整性缺陷的补充证据。

blocks.en: This example suggests that the current framework may be less effective when manipulation evidence is spatially diffuse, background-dominated, or naturally explainable in isolation. Nevertheless, its intermediate reasoning remains better calibrated than vanilla inference, as it identifies a relevant local cue without treating it as conclusive evidence.
blocks.zh: 这个例子表明,当操纵证据在空间上分散、以背景为主或孤立地自然解释时,目前的框架可能不太有效。 尽管如此,它的中间推理仍然比香草推论更有校准性,因为它确定了相关的局部提示,而没有将其作为确凿的证据。

blocks.en: F. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: F. 执行细节

blocks.en: We instantiate the three-stage framework identically across all evaluated backbones, changing only the quantities that are inherently architecture-dependent: the decoder layer/head counts L , H L,H , the visual-token grid H v × W v H_{v}\times W_{v} , and the steering layer range ℒ ⋆ \mathcal{L}^{\star} . All other hyperparameters are shared, apart from two adjustments required by the hybrid attention design of Qwen3.5-9B, which we state explicitly below. This section gives the concrete instantiation for InternVL-3.5-8B, the backbone used for the ablation studies, and describes how the remaining backbones differ.
blocks.zh: 我们以同样的方式在所有评价的骨干上对三阶段框架进行即时分析,只改变本质上依赖架构的数量:解码器层/头数 L, H L, H, 视觉磁盘网格 H v × W v H_{v}\times W_{v}v}v}, 方向层范围为 L \ mathcal{L}^{\star}。 除了Wen3.5-9B混合注意力设计所需的两个调整外,所有其他超参数都是共享的,我们在下文中明确指出。 本节给出了用于断裂研究的骨干InternVL-3.5-8B的混凝土瞬间,并描述了剩余骨干的差异.

blocks.en: Model and inference environment. InternVL-3.5-8B pairs a 448 × 448 448\times 448 InternViT vision encoder (patch size 14, 0.5 × 0.5\times pixel-shuffle downsampling) with a 36-layer, 32-head Qwen3 decoder (8 key–value heads under grouped-query attention). We disable dynamic image tiling ( max_num=1 ), so every image is encoded as a single tile of H v × W v = 16 × 16 = 256 H_{v}\times W_{v}=16\times 16=256 visual tokens. All backbones run in bfloat16 on a single GPU. Because Stage 1 and Stage 3 both require materialized per-head attention weights, we load the model with FlashAttention2 disabled and request output_attentions=True ; region-wise steering (Stage 3.a) is implemented as a forward-pass patch over the decoder’s self-attention module rather than a modification to the generation config. All generation calls – the Stage 1 fixed continuation, Stage 3.a region inspection, and Stage 3.b final aggregation – use greedy decoding ( do_sample=False , one beam), so outputs are deterministic given fixed weights and inputs.

blocks.en: Hybrid-attention backbones: Qwen3.5-9B. Qwen3.5-9B is architecturally hybrid, and is the one backbone that required an adjustment beyond ℒ ⋆ \mathcal{L}^{\star} and the grid. Of its L = 32 L=32 decoder layers, only eight use full self-attention – layers { 3 , 7 , 11 , 15 , 19 , 23 , 27 , 31 } \{3,7,11,15,19,23,27,31\} , with H = 16 H=16 heads each – while the remaining 24 use linear (GatedDeltaNet) attention and are therefore not steerable under our formulation. We accordingly set ℒ ⋆ \mathcal{L}^{\star} to this fixed eight-layer subset and steer all 16 heads of any layer it selects. This leaves only 128 candidate layer–head cells, an order of magnitude fewer than the other backbones, so the shared minimum-peak-distance gate (default 2 grid cells) admits only about 9 of the intended K H = 20 K_{H}=20 heads on this backbone; we therefore lower it to 1 for Qwen3.5-9B alone, which restores selection to 15–17 heads at a modest cost in spatial diversity among the selected heads. Its visual-token grid H v × W v H_{v}\times W_{v} is likewise smaller than the other backbones’ and varies slightly across images because preprocessing preserves the input aspect ratio. Finally, because its responses are longer, we raise its Stage 3 region-inspection and final-aggregation budgets to 256 and 512 generated tokens (versus 96 and 384 elsewhere) to avoid truncation. All remaining hyperparameters are unchanged.

Vanilla inference and our method use the same InternVL-3.5-8B backbone, BF16 precision, 448 × 448 448\times 448 inputs, and single-GPU execution. An invocation denotes either an autoregressive generation or an explicit attention forward evaluation, rather than an individual decoding step.

blocks.en: The increase in invocation count does not produce a proportional increase in runtime because the additional calls are substantially cheaper than a full vanilla generation. Our method distributes a comparable overall generation budget across short intermediate outputs and final aggregation, rather than repeating a full-length response at every stage. In addition, Stage 1 generates the continuation only once and reuses it for the raw and blurred attention evaluations, avoiding an additional autoregressive generation. Stage 2 consists only of lightweight thresholding and connected-component processing, while the regional inspections produce short, structured observations.
blocks.zh: 援引次数的增加不会导致运行时间的按比例增加,因为额外通话比完整的香草一代要便宜得多。 我们的方法将一个可比的总体生成预算分配给短期中间产出和最后汇总,而不是在每个阶段重复一个完整的反应。 此外,第一阶段只产生一次续作,再用于原始的和模糊的注意力评价,避免了额外的自动生成. 第二阶段仅包括轻量级阈值和连接组件处理,而区域视察则产生短小、结构化的观测结果。

blocks.en: The limited memory increase also follows from the sequential design. All stages reuse the same backbone, and the additional attention maps and steering states are transient rather than maintained as parallel model branches. Overall, the proposed framework introduces a moderate 48.0 % 48.0\% latency overhead and approximately 3.1 % 3.1\% additional peak GPU memory despite requiring nearly seven high-level invocations. This indicates that its computational cost grows substantially more slowly than invocation count while supporting multi-stage region mining and evidence aggregation.
blocks.zh: 有限的内存增加也源于顺序设计. 所有阶段都重复使用相同的主干线,额外的关注图和引导状态是短暂的,而不是作为平行的模型分支保持的. 总体来说,拟议框架引入了中度48.0%的48.0%的延迟管理费和大约3.1%的3.1%的额外的顶峰GPU内存,尽管需要近7个高级别引用。 这表明其计算成本的增长大大慢于援引计算,同时支持多阶段区域采矿和证据汇总。

blocks.en: All evaluated backbones use the same Stage 3 prompting protocol: they inspect only the attention-guided local region, compare it with nearby visual context, and produce structured observations instead of image-level decisions. The retained observations are then verified under a full-image view before generating the final prediction and explanation.
blocks.zh: 所有被评价的骨干都使用相同的第3阶段的提示协议:它们只检查受注意引导的局部区域,与附近的视觉环境进行比较,产生结构化的观测而不是图像级的决定. 然后,在得出最后的预测和解释之前,通过全图像视角对保留的观测结果进行核查。

blocks.en: To accommodate differences in instruction following, output-format compliance, and confidence calibration across MLLM backbones, we apply only minor wording adjustments to the shared prompts. These changes do not affect the region proposals, attention steering, evidence schema, filtering rules, or evidence-before-judgment workflow.
blocks.zh: 为了适应在以下指令、产出格式合规性以及MLLM主干线的信任度校准方面的差异,我们对共享提示只做了一些措辞上的调整。 这些变化不影响区域提案、注意方向、证据计划、过滤规则或判决前证据工作流程。

blocks.en: Prompt S1: Region-Wise Evidence Inspection. You are a forensic media authenticity inspector performing a local region-level inspection. Inspect only the attention-guided local region. Do not make the final image-level authentic/manipulated decision at this stage. Examine the strongest visible property within the guided region and compare the local structure with its nearest relevant visual context, such as an adjacent boundary, surface, body part, object, shadow, reflection, or repeated pattern. Focus on concrete and observable visual evidence rather than speculation. Classify the local observation as: • yes : a specific localized contradiction consistent with editing or synthesis is clearly visible; • uncertain : a visible irregularity exists, but a plausible natural explanation remains; • no : the local structure appears visually coherent. Generic blur, smoothness, compression, focus variation, lighting variation, or image quality alone is not sufficient manipulation evidence. The artifact type should describe the concrete visible cue being evaluated rather than an inferred manipulation process. Return exactly: • Observation: < < one concise sentence describing the local comparison and visible result > > • Manipulation Evidence: yes / no / uncertain • Confidence: high / medium / low • Artifact Type: < < short visual artifact or none > > • Natural Explanation: < < brief explanation for no or uncertain; otherwise none > >

blocks.en: Prompt S2: Global Evidence Aggregation. You are a forensic media authenticity inspector. Determine whether the provided image is authentic or manipulated. The region-level observations below are tentative candidate cues rather than verified findings. First verify whether each retained cue is visibly supported by the full image and consistent with its surrounding visual context. Give greater weight to specific localized contradictions in boundary, texture, geometry, lighting, shadow, reflection, object structure, occlusion, or physical contact than to generic image properties. Weak or ambiguous observations should be treated as lower-confidence cues when a plausible natural explanation remains. Repeated observations describing the same underlying visual effect should be consolidated rather than counted as independent evidence. A mostly natural-looking image does not invalidate a concrete local contradiction, but normal global context may weaken generic or unsupported cues. Retained region-level observations: Filtered Region Observations Base the final decision on the specificity, visual support, consistency, and overall strength of the verified evidence. Return exactly: Forensic Analysis: < < In one or two sentences, summarize which local cues remain visually supported after the full-image verification and how strongly they support the manipulation hypothesis. > > Final Decision: Likely Authentic or Likely Manipulated. Artifact Findings: - Title of artifact: < < short visual artifact or none > > - Reason: < < brief technical rationale grounded in visible evidence > >
